communityUi.aiPolicyIntro: Generates text using your connected AI API. Charges may apply (within your budget limit if set).
communityUi.consentDesc: Enabling runs this plugin's code and grants all requested permissions below — partial grants are not supported.
communityUi.consentCodeChanged: This plugin's files have changed since it was last enabled. Do not enable unless you modified them yourself.
communityUi.consentHighRiskNote: Includes 'High' risk permissions. AI calls may incur API costs, and reading chat allows the plugin to see conversation messages.
communityUi.hostSuspended: Plugin ''{id}'' was stopped due to repeated errors. You can re-enable it in Settings.
communityUi.hostCooldownDenied: AI call was just denied by the user — please wait before retrying
communityUi.hostAlreadyAsking: Another AI call confirmation is already open — wait until it finishes
communityUi.installDescUpdate: A plugin with the same ID is already installed and its files will be replaced.
communityUi.installDescNew: Installed plugins start disabled. You will review and grant permissions when enabling.
communityUi.installWarnBold: Only install from sources you trust.
communityUi.installWarnTail: They run in an isolated sandbox with only granted permissions, but can perform anything you allow.
communityUi.installPermsAddedTail: Installing disables this plugin until you review and approve the expanded permissions.
communityUi.logDesc: Up to 200 recent entries. Cleared when the app restarts.
communityUi.permNone: Requests no permissions. Cannot read or modify data or add UI elements.

permSimple.messages_process_desc: Reads new AI replies and attaches notes. Can also edit reply text when auto-fix is enabled (originals are kept and reversible).
permSimple.prompt_modify_desc: Adds rules or instructions before sending to AI, affecting responses (cannot edit or remove existing prompt blocks).
permSimple.ui_panel_desc: Displays this plugin's custom view in the right side panel.
permSimple.ui_command_desc: Adds items to the titlebar plugin commands menu. Runs only when clicked.
permSimple.ai_desc: Generates text with your connected AI API. May incur costs (subject to budget limits and logged in Activity).
permSimple.storage_desc: Private key-value storage isolated to this plugin (up to 1MB).

communityUi.permReadOtherDesc: Reads {kind} text fields (name, description, etc.). File paths are not exposed.
communityUi.permWriteDesc: Proposes changes to {kind}. Changes apply only after your review and approval, and can be reverted.
communityUi.panelUnavailableDesc: The plugin is disabled or stopped.
communityUi.proposalsDesc: Originals are untouched until you apply. Applied changes can be reverted as long as they haven't been edited again.
communityUi.proposalsOutdated: The original was modified after this proposal was created. Please reject it.
communityUi.proposalsCannotRevertTitle: Cannot revert because it was edited again after applying
communityUi.routerBadJson: Arguments cannot be serialized as JSON
communityUi.settingsSecretWarn: Values entered here can be read by this plugin. Do not enter passwords or API keys.
